summary: Updates report their state more accurately, and Invardia Support keeps the access it needs to help you.

fixes.title: No false out-of-date reports
fixes.text: An update now retries a part whose request was lost on the network, instead of reporting it out of date.

fixes.title: Invardia Support access stays in place
fixes.text: PIM Manager never removes the Invardia Support app's database access, and the setup check now finds that access reliably.

fixes.title: Safer move to the sign-in front
fixes.text: The move to the sign-in front waits until the new version is running before it switches the old sign-in off.
